## Progress

- Merged [PR #1437](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/1437): 76 India dental procedures (adapted from DentalERP, MIT) with code, length, editable INR price, SAC 999312 and GST on the 8 cosmetic rows; loaded from Settings › Dental in one transaction with one audit event; loading again adds nothing; India only
- Needs a person: a dentist signs off the 76 fees and a chartered accountant confirms the GST treatment (MDV-P4-031); see the session handoff

## Description

A starter list of dental procedures (consultation, scaling, filling by surfaces, root canal by canals, extraction, crown, bridge, denture, implant stages, orthodontic visits) loaded into the services catalogue with editable fees. India consultations stay GST-exempt; UAE carries VAT and the code set the payer requires.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** The owner can load, edit and price the dental list from Settings → Services.
- [ ] **AC2.** Fees are integer minor units with currency (AGENTS.md 3.4).
- [ ] **AC3.** The licence terms of any UAE dental code set are recorded before it is loaded.

## Notes / open questions

- Source: DentalERP (github.com/abinauv/dental-erp, MIT; reference reviewed 17 Nov 2026).
- Data to take: prisma/seed-data/IN/procedures.ts, 76 dental procedures with code, name, category, duration, INR price, pre and post instructions. Convert prices to integer paise; map the 10 `ProcedureCategory` values (Diagnostic, Preventive, Restorative, Endodontic, Periodontic, Prosthodontic, Orthodontic, Oral surgery, Cosmetic, Emergency) to service groups. A dentist reviews names and default fees before release.
- No UAE set exists there (only IN, US, DE); the UAE list and payer codes are new work.
- Code to read: app/api/procedures, app/api/settings/procedures (catalogue screens); lib/treatment-utils.ts `procedureCategoryConfig` for labels.
